verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an online registered-agent service, for example acting automatically on received mail or compliance deadlines, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no first-party content: the robots.txt probe was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge. The only community item comments on the company's SEO and says nothing about automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
